note: Both sets mix real dimensions from the six elevation blocks with speculative bindings, but Set A is more faithful overall: it correctly ties 13'-3 3/4" and 2'-11 3/16" to the West Living elevation, counts the three MWL01 units there, and keeps the TV-above-MWL01 relation. Set B misassigns more values to the wrong elevation (7'-6" and 2 5/8" are North Bedroom/West Bedroom values labeled as North Living/North Bedroom, 9'-2" is not a West Living dimension) and adds invented qualifiers such as MWD01 = "wall panel/door", "excluding trim/frame overlap", and a non-existent "Interior Elevation E". Set A's main faults are the unsupported W2 "depth" and P3 "offset from top edge" bindings plus two values (1'-5 3/4", 9'-10 1/4") attributed to the wrong elevation. Set B does capture the East Bedroom 8'-8 3/8" width and the 1'-6" TV-to-MWL01 offset that Set A leaves vague, but its error count is higher.
